Hi Marcus / team — Jacob here from Orchidia security. Sorry for the slight delay. Answers below and I've attached the redacted SOC2 executive summary for immediate review. We can grant read-only access to the full report via the DocuSign flow once the access MOU is signed.

1) Data at rest encryption: Customer data at rest is encrypted with Orchidia-managed KMS by default (AWS KMS). We offer CMK (customer-managed keys) for enterprise customers under our Dedicated/Private offering; that requires a feature flag in the onboarding order. Key rotation: automated yearly rotation for Orchidia-managed keys; CMK rotation schedule follows customer KMS policy.

2) Cross-region replication: Backups for the multi-tenant hosted service are stored in US regions only; for EU or APAC customers we use regionally isolated buckets. No subprocessors hold unrestricted copies of PII outside the listed regions. See Orchidia_Subprocessors_v2.csv for processor locations; the CSV also marks whether the processor handles backups.

3) Access controls: We maintain org-level role-based access with customer-scoped logging and per-customer access review for privileged admin actions. Last privileged-access audit: 2028-03-12 — no critical findings; two low findings were remediated by 2028-04-20. Full audit note included in SOC2 report appendix.

Attachments included: Orchidia_SOC2_Report_Q4_2027.pdf (redacted executive summary)

PO notes for Kimberly/Irene: reference ORCH-3341 on your PO and send to accounts@orchidia.io. Once PO is received we will provision onboarding and (if applicable) enable CMK support in the next sprint. If you need a standalone vendor add form completed for Redwood's vendor portal, I can fill that and send back.

Happy to hop on a 30-minute technical call Friday morning PT to walk through any of this with Marcus and the infra team.
